summary: Survival racing with action car battles—drive, upgrade fast, and destroy enemies
description:
SURVIVAL RACING SIMULATION GAME!
Car Eats Car 3: Survival Racing is a free mobile racing game with action-packed police chases and car battles. Join the series with 50+ MILLION DOWNLOADS!

TURBO-BOOSTED CARS IN ACTION RACING
Drive turbo cars in a colorful arcade world. Play online or offline with vehicles like the red car “Beetlee”, tractor “Harvester”, battle machine “Locomachine”, police racer “Francopstein”, and “Tankominator”. Start your engines, hit nitro, and survive every chase!

DRIVE, OVERTAKE, SURVIVE
Win races, collect cars, and upgrade your garage to defeat rivals. Outrun enemies, dodge traps, and finish first in this fast 2D racing adventure. Every level pushes your driving skills: tight jumps, tricky landings, and high-speed escapes.

POLICE CHASE ACTION
No fines… but the chase is on! Drive at full speed and escape cops, enemies, and end bosses. Each run is a challenge—use nitro boosts, master flips and stunts, and prove you’re the king of the road.

PICK THE RIGHT CAR FOR EACH MISSION
Choose the best vehicle for every level and situation. Some cars are built for speed, others for armor and battle. Upgrade your collection with turbo boost to stay ahead of the police and dominate the race track. Action battles and racing challenges await in every run.

MISSIONS, EVENTS & PROGRESSION
Play special missions and game events to earn rewards and unlock new race cars. Build your full garage and rule across multiple game sections. Complete challenges, grab loot, and climb through the ranks with every upgrade.

UPGRADE NITRO & EQUIP WEAPONS
To get enemies off your back, upgrade cars with extra speed, ammo, weapons, nitro, and turbo boosts. Build unique cars from parts you win by completing levels and missions. Use powerful gadgets to slow opponents and take control of the race—freeze, disrupt, or push them off course at the right moment.

BATTLE OR ESCAPE WITH TURBO SPEED
Unlock, upgrade, and boost new cars, monster trucks, 4x4 vehicles, and support drones. Collect coins to improve racing speed, armor, and turbo. Explore exotic locations and complete action missions—city streets, dusty desert roads, and island routes. Flips and stunts charge your turbo, so don’t forget to stunt before you boost!

THE KING OF THE ROAD
Become the king of chase racing and drive against the police. Overtake cop cars, survive ambushes, and outsmart bosses with smart upgrades and perfect timing. Insane speed and battle power matter in this massive racing world!

FREE YOUR FRIENDS
Drive with no fear and help friends captured by the police. Break them out, finish your missions, and keep your racing buddies safe. Take the wheel and drive!

FEATURES
🚗 146 unique levels (including uphill tracks)
🚗 48 battle chase levels in the Dungeon
🚗 43 cars to unlock and upgrade
🚗 Unique skills for every car
🚗 40 enemies to defeat — Speed & Turbo!
🚗 11 end bosses in special battle missions
🚗 2 mini games: Ruby Hunt and Carkanoid
🚗 15 special Carkanoid levels
🚗 Unlock cars and bonuses in INCUBATOR, FRIENDOPEDIA, and POLICEPEDIA

Do you like survival racing, police chases, and car battle action? Enter the world of Car Eats Car 3: Survival Racing and enjoy the ride!

Car Eats Car 3 is free to play but contains paid content. You can unlock content with Google Play Pass (if available).

We update the game regularly with your suggestions—leave a review and help us improve!
